course.name: Inner Circle Trader (ICT)
course.tagline: A free forex and futures price-action education library built by Michael J. Huddleston, one of the most-referenced names in retail price-action trading.
course.about: Inner Circle Trader (ICT) is the trading education work of Michael J. Huddleston, focused on a price-action methodology he calls "Trading the Markets". The core 137-article curriculum and years of mentorship cohorts have been released free on YouTube; a separate paid mentorship has historically existed for traders wanting guided, live application with trade reviews.

_notes.source: One of the most-referenced names in retail forex/futures price-action trading (an enormous YouTube following and widely-copied terminology), added for directory credibility rather than affiliate revenue — no affiliate relationship exists. Founder confirmed on theinnercircletrader.com. A historical paid mentorship (reported around $100/month on a 12-month basis in 2022) appears to have existed, but we couldn't confirm a currently-active paid price for 2026, so pricing only shows the free tier rather than guessing a possibly-outdated figure. Trustpilot (3.1/5, 47 reviews, Average) confirmed directly. No usable logo found (the official site's favicon didn't resolve), so a lettermark shows instead.
